LESSON: LANGUAGE USE 7.3.1 SIMPLE PAST TENSE (ADDING -ED/- D)

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding -ed/- d)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding -ed/- d), part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: What did you do in the morning before coming to school? 2. What did your family do last Saturday to keep the home clean?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 7.3.1 Simple past tense (adding -ed/- d) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: learning independently is enhanced as the learner practices using verbs in simple past tense to express what they did in

the past.

● Communication: learner speaking clearly and attentively is enhanced as they use appropriate language structure to respond to questions

related to the theme.

Values:
Respect: is enhanced as learners appreciate each other’s opinion as they engage in language games.
